newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Commodity prices to support A$ - Macquarie.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Commodity prices to support A$ - Macquarie.

text.p: Improving world economic conditions will directly benefit Australia by pushing commodity prices higher this year, Macquarie Bank Ltd chief economist Bill Shields said on Tuesday.
Shields said he expected commodity prices to rise by about 3.5 percent in 1997 on a trade weighted basis, with metals recording the largest individual rises.
"This should also support a slightly higher exchange rate to around US$0.80 or higher by year's end," Shields said.
The Australian dollar was trading at US$0.7641/46 at the midsession on Tuesday.

In 1997, industralised economies are forecast to grow by between two and 2.5 percent, while growth rates in Asia would be around 7.5 to 8 percent, Shields said in a speech to the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economic (ABARE) Outlook conference.
